name: iPNDM
plain: Improved pseudo-numerical method: Adams-Bashforth history on slopes with fixed textbook coefficients, up to order 4, one call per step. The coefficients assume even step size in σ, whatever the schedule actually is. The sibling ipndm_v adapts them.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
Order=min(4,i+1). x'=x+(σ'−σ)·G, with G=d; (3d−d₁)/2; (23d−16d₁+5d₂)/12; (55d−59d₁+37d₂−9d₃)/24.
